verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes review of the project change as the required engineering task; the excluded turnaround and fee do not enter the Event payload.

The client narrows the engineering review to the minor electrical modifications documented in the Word file rather than all 84 pages; replacing review_scope leaves no obsolete attribute requiring removal.

The client establishes the review acceptance outcome: approve the Word-file electrical revisions so the as-built electrical sheets can be amended; this adds a deliverable-relevant condition without conflicting stale attributes.
